citation: Wheeler, Mortimer. 1968. The Indus Civilization. 3rd ed. Supplementary volume to The Cambridge History of India. Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. ISBN 0521069580.
notes: Classic secondary synthesis (3rd ed. 1968), historically influential on citadel/lower-town and ‘priest-king’ framings. Many interpretations are outdated relative to post-1980s Harappa Project and settlement archaeology — register for research-history orientation and as a foil Kenoyer 1991 revises. Do not use Wheeler absolute dates or invasion narratives as current fact.
